integrity: The stationary state and Wootters concurrence are reconstructed analytically. A separately constructed physical Lindbladian and Wootters spin-flip computation were run successfully; finite checks do not substitute for universal algebraic arguments. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two exchange-coupled qubits; strictly positive independent local raising and lowering rates with equal total rate; unconditional unique stationary state. The threshold is not proved for unequal total local rates, collective dissipation, non-Markovian dynamics, or multi-qubit extensions. A related extreme one-pump/one-loss conference contribution was accessible only in abstract; prior equivalent treatments remain possible.
title: Sharp reservoir-contrast threshold for stationary entanglement in an exchange-coupled qubit pair
